violated_contract: A transient OAuth refresh storage failure or concurrent duplicate refresh must not cause unhandled server errors or permanent whole-grant authentication loss.
canonical_prevention: Bound refresh rotation to three fresh Firestore transactions for classified transient errors, return typed retryable unavailability after exhaustion, tolerate used-token replay only within a fixed grace window without extending it, preserve marker-first revocation beyond grace, and count bounded terminal outcomes at the token handler.
